mapper.sql: request_id, event_id::text AS event_id, correlation_id, client_id, source_system_id, request_type, TO_CHAR(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS occurred_at, TO_CHAR(received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS received_at, status, representative_id, representative_name, representative_email, representative_phone, organization_code, organization_name, business_number, target_user_id, target_user_name, target_user_email, target_user_phone, target_user_position, reason, metadata_json::text AS metadata_json, content_sha256, decision_comment, decided_by_user_cd, decided_by_user_id, decided_by_user_name, CASE WHEN decided_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(decided_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') END AS decided_at, TO_CHAR(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS updated_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM docs_distribution_account_request_nonce WHERE received_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{value} * INTERVAL '1 day')
mapper.select: INSERT INTO docs_distribution_account_request ( event_id, correlation_id, client_id, source_system_id, request_type, occurred_at, received_at, status, representative_id, representative_name, representative_email, representative_phone, organization_code, organization_name, business_number, target_user_id, target_user_name, target_user_email, target_user_phone, target_user_position, reason, metadata_json, content_sha256, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{eventId} AS uuid), #{correlationId}, #{clientId}, #{sourceSystemId}, #{requestType}, CAST(#{occurredAt} AS timestamptz), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'PENDING', #{representativeId}, #{representativeName}, #{representativeEmail}, NULLIF(#{representativePhone}, ''), NULLIF(#{organizationCode}, ''), NULLIF(#{organizationName}, ''), NULLIF(#{businessNumber}, ''), #{targetUserId}, NULLIF(#{targetUserName}, ''), NULLIF(#{targetUserEmail}, ''), NULLIF(#{targetUserPhone}, ''), NULLIF(#{targetUserPosition}, ''), NULLIF(#{reason}, ''), CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb), #{contentSha256}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING request_id
SELECT FROM docs_distribution_account_request WHERE source_system_id = #{sourceSystemId} AND event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS uuid)
SELECT FROM docs_distribution_account_request WHERE request_id = #{value} FOR UPDATE

SELECT request_event_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, actor_name, comment, TO_CHAR(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS occurred_at FROM docs_distribution_account_request_event WHERE request_id = #{value} ORDER BY request_event_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_distribution_account_request_event ( request_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, actor_name, comment, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, 'RECEIVED', NULL, 'PENDING', 'EXTERNAL_SYSTEM', #{representativeId}, #{representativeName}, NULLIF(#{reason}, ''), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE docs_distribution_account_request SET status = #{targetStatus}, decision_comment = NULLIF(#{comment}, ''), decided_by_user_cd = #{actor.userCd}, decided_by_user_id = #{actor.userId}, decided_by_user_name = #{actor.userNm}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_distribution_account_request_event ( request_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, actor_type, actor_id, actor_name, comment, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, 'TDMS_USER', #{actor.userId}, #{actor.userNm}, NULLIF(#{comment}, ''), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
